remainingBoundedGaps.title: Complete scaled kernel decision
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: Scaling, one RBF similarity and reporting are each tested separately, but no item carries a new three-channel measurement through the complete fitted scale/kernel/score/class decision.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add one bounded integrated exercise with explicitly supplied training statistics, support vectors, signed coefficients/intercept and score convention, or an equivalently reproducible source-model inference trace. remainingBoundedGaps.title: Complete inverse-regression task-space decision
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: The bank has a good one-weight training update, FK examples, shape checks and historical residual norm, but does not numerically connect a new two-output regression result with branch/range validity and task-space comparison.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Replace redundant P1737-Q01 or add a bounded exercise using declared predicted angle pairs and source geometry; compute both task-space errors, check branch/workspace assumptions and choose a prediction under an explicit criterion. Include a meaningful comparison with angle-space error or a wrap-boundary case, without inventing live-model accuracy.

remainingBoundedGaps.title: Report macro versus support-weighted averages
remainingBoundedGaps.finding: The actual classification report displays macro and weighted averages, while the current questions cover only per-class precision/recall/F1/support and overall accuracy.
remainingBoundedGaps.remedy: Add a numerical interpretation using explicitly supplied imbalanced class supports and per-class scores, or equivalent confusion counts. Distinguish macro and support-weighted averaging and explain why the balanced perfect source output conceals the difference.
